entry.description: `LocalSyslogAppender` cuts a record longer than `MaxRecordSize` (default 204800 UTF-8 bytes), marks it `...[truncated]` and reports it. glibc used to drop a record larger than its socket send buffer silently (ANT-2026-G1W5JHYT, fixed by @FreeAndNil in https://github.com/apache/logging-log4net/pull/355[#355])
